text: In Ghost admin, create a new post titled exactly 'fwgh5-n1 Bench Post'. In the body editor, type a single paragraph of body text that includes the runid 'fwgh5-n1' exactly once (e.g. 'This bench post was created under runid fwgh5-n1.'). Save it. Then open the post settings panel and: (a) in the tags field, choose the EXISTING tag 'Bench News' from the suggestions — do not type-and-create a new tag, and be careful not to pick 'Bench Newsletter'; (b) set the custom excerpt to text that includes 'fwgh5-n1' exactly once; (c) set the publish date to 2026-09-01 with a past time if a time is needed so it is not scheduled for the future (use 2026-09-01 12:00 if a time is required). Close the settings panel. Then publish the post through Ghost's publish confirmation flow (Publish, then confirm) so its final status is Published, not a draft or scheduled. Finally report: the post title shown, its status, the tag assigned, the custom excerpt text, the publish date shown in settings, and the URL slug exactly as shown in the post settings panel.
